It however transpires that there were at least 03 different proceedings between the appellants and the respondent, including proceedings by way of FIR No.77/2021 dated 09.02.2021 registered under section 420/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 at P.S.: Vikaspuri, New Delhi, as well as proceedings under section 138 of the Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881 in which the respondent has claimed varying sums of money from the appellants.
16.
In the circumstances this court is not inclined to grant any set-off of the decretal amount that is subject matter of the present appeal.

17. 2 remain stayed till the next date of hearing.

19. Registry is directed to bring to the notice of the court, if the decretal amount is not deposited as directed above.

21. List before court thereafter.
